messages:
Nina: Heads up: I apologized to the model today. whispered 'sorry, messy prompt' like it's a coworker. :sweat_smile:
Evan: same. mine got a 'pls be gentle' at 8:30am. we should make an official emoji.
Kai: Proposal: stickers that say 'be kind to the model' and 'feed prompts, not snacks'. who's in?
Leah: I'm in. design-bot made 3 mockups: `// tiny gpu mascot`, `// sleepy decoder`, `// coffee-cup transformer` — all adorable.
design-bot: uploaded: `be-kind-sticker-v1.png, sleepy-decoder-v2.svg` :sparkles:
Nina: poll time: which mascot for the sticker run? 1) Tiny GPU with sunglasses 2) Sleepy decoder with blanket 3) Coffee-cup transformer 4) Keyboard cat model
Evan: vote: 1
Kai: vote: 2
Leah: vote: 3 (keyboard cat is tempting though)
lunchbot: Lunch special: "Prompt & Pickles" combo. Promo: PROMPTPICKLE
Nina: follow-up: also thinking of a small ritual: before big demos, we 'thank the model' for its service. theatrical or sincere?
Evan: theatrical. bring on the tiny applause emote.
Kai: adding to culture doc: 'Model Therapy' — rituals, stickers, and a recommended prompt template for clarity.
Leah: can someone make a slack emoji :thanks-model: so I can bless responses? :pray:
Nina: @Leah I'm ordering 50 stickers now. first batch will go on monitors. closing thread with: treat prompts like plants — clearer instructions, occasional praise, no overwatering. :seedling:
